# Ask the Board — Multi-Voice Deliberation Panel

Curated by Skill Harbor — when a decision deserves more than one head, it convenes a structured deliberation panel: multiple voices arguing from distinct personas or judging lenses, with explicit role definitions, turn-taking, and convergence toward a recommendation. Use it to stress-test a business decision, workshop a creative direction, or run a judging panel for submissions — the structure keeps the debate honest instead of collapsing into your own first instinct wearing costumes. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @sayewich. Honest caveats: the voices are all your Muse in different hats — it widens perspectives, it doesn't add real expertise you don't already have access to; define the roles and the decision question precisely, or the panel debates the wrong thing; for high-stakes calls, real humans still beat simulated ones. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
